about: Every key that may appear in the venue's Solana programs (our copies of cp-swap and tegridy-clmm, and our own tegridy-launch and bayla-ladder), each named. key-guard.mjs fails on any other key, on any key the pinned upstream hard-codes, and on any entry here that appears nowhere. Change this list only in a pull request of its own (provenance.mjs --pr-files).

ours.7ghzbbmq59QEbdweSzM1ggpeBH1Q2CyxZg4Tr2x8: tegridy-clmm's program id, made by the owner on 2026-10-21; its upgrade authority is the vault once deployed (docs/RANGE_POOLS_PLAN.md step 7).
ours.RangePoo1DEVNETarmNotDep1oyed11111111111: tegridy-clmm's id in a devnet build only: not a key, nobody can deploy at it, so a devnet build (every power to a test key) runs nowhere. The release build never names it.
ours.GRMtSxgseKdesExU1BQ22abEspTXV55UPcLaHCd1: The venue's Squads v4 vault (vault 0 of multisig EVGSnRZFWqjCaWR7z2xKbSXnuddY8upevEQK5HFmj6NK, two signatures). Mainnet admin, fee owner and fee receiver of both programs.
ours.EVGSnRZFWqjCaWR7z2xKbSXnuddY8upevEQK5HFm: The venue's Squads multisig account that owns the vault. Named only in a cp-swap comment; it can sign nothing.
ours.2sa31zceMSTAAbSu5wfSnNA6sBYzS7r97nvZYaQo: The vault's wrapped-SOL account: cp-swap's mainnet pool-opening fee lands here.
ours.EKS4C6xvV9A5DMWaWtVnFvi7ru78EhqRAoddEMpQ: cp-swap's mainnet program id, the venue's own key (owner ruling 2026-09-25).
ours.BvBkt84ZiKmiPSuWrdefxbxPTX5YiLnU6YEGtY6p: cp-swap's devnet program id, the venue's own key.
ours.GgE6AfEH2AVSrKGckyKMzC6mhtXWiAn39EzAikAs: The venue's devnet admin key. Devnet arms only, in both programs; devnet coins have no value.
ours.27AC7YwwAULHQcQXGErV7rHMsLZAUBWF6ozDNhSp: The devnet admin's wrapped-SOL account: cp-swap's devnet pool-opening fee lands here.
ours.64WBTeNcrSHfmBpiqymyifW6FUNNLvJcuiqF9rXm: tegridy-launch's program id (its declare_id!, the restart id its host test pins).
ours.CqcVvaMvesrSKrUSbqBqr9mLjKLJuYqhaXg1gXpR: tegridy-launch's mainnet deployer: the one key allowed to call initialize_global (deployer::ID, mainnet arm).
ours.EMQVYMPe2UffGAVNYK6ZveCFM2tHjc5DBiXGKYFE: tegridy-launch's devnet deployer placeholder (deployer::ID, devnet arm). solana-ci's launch-constraints job overwrites it with a fresh wallet before its builds.
ours.3ZvZXEBr21Kz7JeWFCeKv8Hyy8AzHqCSXNjif8QH: A spent cp-swap program id. Named only in tegridy-launch's host test, which asserts the pin is never this id again.
ours.CpFnacrACftonjeQ4hJBkja3PkrwvFSRFzBEk9oK: A spent cp-swap program id. Named only in tegridy-launch's host test, which asserts the pin is never this id again.
ours.GKwgTQtVyPGxspxvciDAStY4Jq7rB1STuVvXic7E: bayla-ladder's committed program id, a placeholder made 2026-09-06; solana-deploy-artifact.yml sets the real id at build time (lib.rs says so).
ours.ASLXdST48ivBZ4xV7VjgD51FJ6rHH5CN5s8XS5TL: bayla-ladder's devnet deployer placeholder (deployer::ID, devnet arm). Devnet only.

system.So11111111111111111111111111111111111111: Wrapped SOL mint (SPL Token). Used only inside an upstream unit test in tegridy-clmm states/pool.rs.
system.metaqbxxUerdq28cj1RbAWkYQm3ybzjb6a8bt518: Metaplex Token Metadata program. tegridy-clmm's Anchor.toml copies it onto a local test chain; position NFTs carry its name record.
system.11111111111111111111111111111111: System Program. bayla-ladder's mainnet deployer arm names it as a fail-closed sentinel nobody can sign for.
